facts.fact: The April 2021 presentation by the Ministry of Digital Economy and Digital Transformation (MENTD) says it forms part of the elaboration of the Togo Digital 2025 strategy, whose definition of a strategic roadmap 'a été lancé', with three parts (foundations of digital transformation, digitalisation of public and social services, creation of a digital economy) and nine programmes; no adopting act is given.

The presentation says that in the portfolio identified for the Togo 2025 strategic plan the MENTD leads 6 projects and 1 reform and supports 21 projects and 3 reforms, and that the plan sets it three priority objectives (digitalise state services, make Togo a digital hub, give all citizens internet access); no act is cited.

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Économie Numérique et de la Transformation Digitale (MENTD)

note: Class national rests on the three parts covering both state and economy; the passages do not say the whole government adopted it. No stated period, plan costs or reporting in the passages, so no period/plan/reporting fact.
